android-load-idle.desc: Boot: settings pushed, the 120 ms reporter sends one empty rect list, then nothing while idle.

android-image.desc: Image drop on a phone: mobile CSS (close always visible, no reaction bar), rect reported with key/x/y/w/h, removed after 4 s, reports stop.

steps.step: rect reported, drop fitted on screen

android-move-close.desc: __mdDropCtl.move (clamped to the screen), close (smooth), unknown keys ignored; rects follow.

steps.step: move 1 far off-screen → clamped to bottom-left
closing drop dropped from the report
unknown / removed keys ignored, fit idempotent

android-fit-large.desc: Large image (1200x900 → 78vw) and portrait image: re-fitted on screen once loaded; video rect after metadata, removed at end.

android-test-drop.desc: Test drop from MemeDropService.testDrop() (SVG placeholder) on a phone.

android-settings-live.desc: __mdSettings patch: opacity / theme / volume applied live; spotlight off by default on Android.

steps.step: t=120 duration→1 s: rescheduled, 880 ms left

android-tts-rain.desc: TTS-only + rain on Android: speech fallback once, rain particles, no rect.

android-rapid.desc: 8 drops at once on Android: 6 rects, queued drops get new keys when slots free up.
